# `aitbc start`

Start all AITBC services for the current (or selected) role

## Usage

```bash
aitbc start [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | flag | `false` | no | Show which systemctl commands would run without running them |
| `--role` | choice | — | no | Override the node role (default: auto-detect from /etc/aitbc) |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc start
```
